title: Karnataka High Court bins challenge to Ancient Monuments and Archaeological Sites and Remains Act
description: Karnataka property laws: Karnataka High Court upholds the constitutional validity of the Ancient Monuments Act, dismissing a challenge against construction curbs near protected monuments in the state.

title: Karnataka HC upholds constitutional validity of law on ‘prohibited’ and ‘regulated’ areas around ancient monuments
description: Karnataka HC upholds constitutional validity of law restricting construction within 200m of monuments, with retrospective effect, pending fresh distance survey.

title: New dinosaur species identified from fossil tucked away in a museum
description: “It was not the apex predator of its time, but for humans this dinosaur would have been more dangerous than a T. rex,” Morrison said.

title: Court Cites Ancient Text In 'Rarest Of Rare' Murder Case
description: A Meerut court sentenced a woman and her lover to death on Friday for murdering her husband and staging it as a snakebite. The court cited the Manusmriti and the mythological figure Savitri, calling it a 'rarest of rare' case.

title: Ancient shipwreck found off Turkey may be the world’s oldest
description: Discovery of remains of 4,500-year-old ship reveal new evidence about Early Bronze Age trade routes
